scope: Research writing, thesis infrastructure, scientific papers, researcher workspaces, discussions, presentations and academic web modules

children.role: University manuscript formatting, provenance, semantic science validation
Research presentation generation and evidence/visual QA
Three-format manuscript parity, separate presentation/working records and A7 stable-ID lifecycle

semantic_rules: Academic proof and scientific truth require independently verified evidence; fluent text or a passing build does not establish correctness
Never infer findings, author credentials, university approval or supervisor approval
Thesis formatting and presentation production retain their existing separate specialized authorities
Researcher source/evidence remains private and scoped to the registered researcher
Do not import contract clauses, company branding or enterprise payment logic into academic manuscript controls
A submission Google Doc is an independently verified native representation of the exact admitted LaTeX/PDF revision; audit and discussion remain separate. See RD-LTX-CORE-017.
